## Looking things up

| Question | Where |
|---|---|
| Does object X exist, how many fields | `objects.md`: grep `` `X` `` |
| The fields of X with type, required, read-only and valid values | the `File` / `Line` / `Lines` of X in `objects.md`, then read that range; or grep `## X` in the bundles |
| Which objects have a field F | grep `` `F` `` across the bundles |
| How X relates to Y (the `OBJECTPATH` for `query` dot notation) | X's relationships table |

## Known limits

- `lookup` reports queryable fields and relationships; owned objects (transaction lines) are separate objects, and nothing here says which function creates or updates what: that is the portal reference (`../objects/`).
- One company, one release, standard objects only; custom fields, user-defined dimensions and transaction-definition fields (`docparid`) are not included.
- Dump manifest: 0 objects failed `lookup` and are absent; 0 custom objects, 13 custom fields and 0 relationships to non-standard objects were removed.
- `inspect` lists `SODOCUMENT`, `PODOCUMENT`, `INVDOCUMENT`, their line objects and the recurring variants once per transaction definition; only the generic entry is kept here, and `lookup` was called without `docparid`, so the field lists of those objects are the base fields, without any definition's custom fields.
